title: Peru cements position as world's leading blueberry exporter | News | ANDINA - Peru News Agency - Agencia Andina
summary: Peru has consolidated its position as the world's top exporter of blueberries, reaching a record sales figure of over US$2.27 billion to key global markets by the end of 2024. The season will continue until April of this year, according to the Ministry of Agrarian Development and Irrigation (Midagri).
